text:
peter: heads up folks — publish broke for sdk-node after a fresh typegen run. two things showed up: npm 401 + semver guard blocked the release. opening thread to coordinate.

peter: ```
$ ./scripts/release sdk-node
> typegen: regenerated types (openapi v1.45.1) -> changed export ordering for models/*
> build: ok
> npm publish packages/sdk-node --access public
npm ERR! code E401
npm ERR! 401 Unauthorized - PUT https://registry.npmjs.org/@redwood-inference/sdk-node - must authenticate
Publish aborted: semver-check failed: missing changelog fragment for minor bump (detected non-trivial dist diff)
```

ci-bot: pipeline=publish-sdk job=7019 failed (step=publish) reason="401 + semver-guard" :robot_face:

zoe: did the typegen actually change the external API or just reorder exports? semver checker treats any file-hash change as potentially breaking.

mike: looks like reorder + a rename of an internal helper symbol. nothing external should break but dist hashes differ so semver tool flagged it.

tara: short-term mitigation: add a changelog fragment explaining non-breaking reorder and re-run. long-term: we should canonicalize typegen output (normalize export order) before diffing. filing INF-830.

oliver: the 401 is separate — logs show the publish runner's npm token was rotated mid-job by a credential-rotation workflow. our publish step uses fixed interval retries (3x 2s) and doesn't refresh tokens on retry. registry returned 401 on last attempt. we need exponential backoff + token refresh hook.

peter: i'll add the tiny changelog fragment to scripts/changelog/fragments/sdk-node-typegen.md and re-run job.

ci-bot: job #7020 queued by peter.

mike: i've got a small patch ready for the publish action: https://git.internal/pr/6012 — switches to retryUtil.withBackoff(max=5, base=500ms, jitter=true) and calls tokenService.refresh() before each retry. assigning to zoe for review.

zoe: reviewing now. small nit about refresh timeout; otherwise LGTM.

ci-bot: job #7020 started, step=publish -> npm publish invoked

peter: hit a transient 401 on attempt 2 but retry+refresh logic worked and publish continued. semver fragment satisfied the guard. package published as @redwood-inference/sdk-node@0.12.4.

tara: will add a unit test that simulates token rotation and asserts publish step calls refresh & retries with backoff. PR: https://git.internal/pr/6018

mike: also started RFC INF-RFC-32 for a typegen-normalizer that sorts exports + strips internal helper renames before diffing. @oliver @tara please review — it'll reduce noisy changelog bumps.

oliver: added a quick sampleapp onboarding smoke that performs a mock publish and asserts we don't loop on 401s; added as gating e2e to onboarding pipeline. PR: https://git.internal/pr/6025

zoe: thanks all. plan recap: (1) changelog fragment added & job re-run -> success, (2) publish retry fix merged to main (PR #6012), (3) onboarding e2e added (PR #6025), (4) RFC for typegen-normalizer (INF-RFC-32) filed.

ci-bot: job #7020 succeeded :tada:

peter: closing loop — package live, follow-ups tracked. tagging: @zoe (review RFC), @mike (merge patch), @tara (changelog docs).
